# WIMT Live API

Same API implementation runs on Vercel and Cloudflare Workers. `api/live.js` holds the shared handler; `worker.js` adapts it to the Workers runtime.

## Endpoint

```text
GET /api/live?trainNo=20888&date=2026-10-07&from=BSB&to=RNC&fromDay=1
```

Parameters: five-digit `trainNo`, ISO `date`, station codes `from` and `to`, and optional numeric `fromDay` (defaults to `1`).

## Vercel

Connect this repository with the project root set to the repository root. Vercel detects `api/live.js` as the `/api/live` function. `vercel.json` sets its Mumbai region and 30-second maximum duration. Local development: `npx vercel dev`.

## Cloudflare Workers

Install dependencies and start local development:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev:cloudflare
```

Deploy:

```bash
npm run deploy:cloudflare
```

Wrangler uses `wrangler.jsonc` and `worker.js`; the Worker exposes the same `/api/live` route. Configure optional `WIMT_ENDPOINT`, `WIMT_APP_VERSION`, and `WIMT_USER` variables in each platform’s settings. For local Cloudflare overrides, use `.dev.vars` (ignored by Git).
